title: MemoryRecordsUpdateResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "record_id": string, "revision": int }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.records.update (§7.18): REVISION_CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED, INVALID_INPUT, SUBJECT_FENCED, SPACE_FROZEN. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
